title: Fucus
summary: FU'CUS, noun [Latin See Feign.] 1. A paint; a dye; also, false show. 2. plural fucuses. In botany, a genus of Algae, or seaweed; the sea-wrack, etc.

inlines.v: FU'CUS, noun [Latin See Feign.] 1. A paint; a dye; also, false show. 2. plural fucuses. In botany, a genus of Algae, or seaweed; the sea-wrack, etc.
